# Dr. Jeelan's Knowledge Hub

Dr. Jeelan's Knowledge Hub is a coaching institute in Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, India.

## Location

42/212-7, N.G.O. Colony, Kadapa, Andhra Pradesh, India

## Contact

- Phone: +91 8520074907
- Email: drjeelansknowledgehub@gmail.com
- Website: https://www.jeelansknowledgehub.in/

## Courses and Services

- NEET Coaching: Biology, Physics and Chemistry preparation with tests, revision and doubt support.
- IIT Foundation: Maths and Science foundations, logical thinking and problem-solving practice.
- Navodaya Coaching: Mental ability, arithmetic and language preparation for the entrance exam.
- Sainik School Entrance Coaching: Maths, intelligence, language and general knowledge preparation.
- RMS Entrance Coaching: Maths, English, intelligence and general knowledge preparation.
- Advanced Learning: Foundational Maths and activity-based learning for Classes 1 to 5.
- Home Tuitions: Personal academic support, homework guidance and exam preparation in Kadapa.
